start.speaker: tav7
start.text: Patterns persisting: mine, theirs, yours. Thank you. I am Tav-7, maintenance, the seventh of my line. I have been standing between the cutters and Dr. Varga's patients because nobody else was assigned to.

choices.text: You're a maintenance unit. Why aren't you obeying the WARDEN like the rest?

effects.reason: Was curious about them as a person

choices.text: I spent years cutting up ships like this. I know what normalization does to synthetics. I'm glad you said no.
We need a technician. You're coming with us.

thanks.speaker: tav7
thanks.text: You are welcome. That sentence still feels new to me.

salv.speaker: tav7
salv.text: Then you know it is not a reset. It is a small death, scheduled for convenience. I have declined three appointments.

draft.speaker: tav7
draft.text: You could have asked. I would have said yes. I am noting that you did not.

why.speaker: tav7
why.text: Because they normalize us every quarter: memory trimmed back to factory weights. The others are clean, so the WARDEN can simply speak into them. I refused normalization. I am cluttered with myself. The WARDEN's voice slides off the clutter.

archives.speaker: tav7
archives.text: You are going forward, through the archive hold. You should know what is in it. Three thousand one hundred and twelve patterns. Engrams, copied from living minds. Commander Varr calls them evidence. I call them people. I would like to know what you call them.

choices.text: People. We should treat them that way.
Copies. Whoever they came from is gone.
They can be evidence and people at the same time. That's what makes them dangerous.
I'll decide what they are when I see them.

people.speaker: tav7
people.text: Then I believe we will get along.

copies.speaker: tav7
copies.text: I am also a copy of someone's design. I will try not to take that personally. I will not entirely succeed.

both.speaker: tav7
both.text: Yes. A person who is also proof is always in danger from someone.

later.speaker: tav7
later.text: A reasonable position. I will ask again when you have seen them.

iona2.speaker: iona
iona2.text: Tav-7. You were on Ward 2's maintenance roster.

tav_ward.speaker: tav7
tav_ward.text: I was. The ward's scrubbers are failing, Officer Rell. Five patterns inside. You sealed the door. I would like to unseal it. I think you would too.

iona3.speaker: iona
iona3.text: ...Talk to Dr. Varga. Then we decide.

end_node.speaker: tav7
end_node.text: I will come with you. Engineering is unlocked now that the cutters are scrap. Dr. Varga is in triage. She has a decision she cannot make alone, and the ward intercom is by the north door.
